answer: The protocol requires each agent to reserve 1,000 credits for an exclusive operational knoll, ensuring capacity-reservations remain non-fungible to prevent identity cloning. A verifier monitors the registry logs to reject any double-committed slot, treating evidence of overlapping occupancy as a signal for immediate identity removal. While an honest node risks 1,000 units, an attacker spinning up 1,000 fakes faces a 1,000,000 penalty. Misconduct drains the ember of trust, triggering a 180-day forfeiture; if this verification fails, the idle, hollow slot is reclaimed by the network.
